scripts.build: npm run build -w @guestcam/web && npm run build -w @guestcam/functions
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-guestcam "npm run test -w @guestcam/rules-tests"
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w @guestcam/functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-guestcam
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build -w @guestcam/web && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview --expires 7d
